title: segment share
sql: SELECT Segment, ROUND(SUM(Sales), 0) AS Sales FROM superstore GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

title: sales by state
sql: SELECT State_Province, ROUND(SUM(Sales), 0) AS Sales FROM superstore WHERE Country_Region = 'United States' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

title: region x category
sql: SELECT Region, Category, ROUND(SUM(Profit), 0) AS Profit FROM superstore GROUP BY 1, 2
